# RallyOnly

> RallyOnly is an iPhone app that cuts the dead time out of tennis match videos. You film your match with the normal Camera app, pick the video in RallyOnly, and a video model running on the iPhone finds every point, removes the walking and ball-collecting between points, and builds a two-minute highlight reel of the best rallies. Nothing is uploaded and there is no account.

What it gives you from one recording:

- The condensed match: every point, none of the waiting in between, played from the original video.
- A two-minute highlight reel of the best rallies, picked automatically.
- Every rally ranked, so you can tick the ones you want and build your own reel; serves get their own list.
- Exports in 16:9 (YouTube) or 9:16 (stories, Reels, TikTok). Any rally's start and end can be nudged.

Facts:

- Platform: iPhone only, iOS 17 or later. No Android, no iPad app, no web version.
- Price: free for four new matches a month with every feature (free exports carry a small watermark). RallyOnly Pro removes the limit and the watermark: US$4.99/month or US$34.99/year in the US App Store; new subscribers can start with a free trial. Prices differ by country.
- Speed: roughly a ninth of the recording's length on a recent iPhone, about four minutes for a half-hour session.
- Privacy: analysis runs on the phone; the original is read from Photos, not copied or uploaded.
- It does not record video itself, and it does not do line calls, ball speed or shot statistics.
- Works with GoPro or other camera footage once the video is in the Photos library.
- Languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Simplified Chinese.
- Compared with SwingVision: SwingVision also does line calls, ball speed, stats and in-app recording, and costs more (from US$14.99/month). RallyOnly does only the part that removes the time between points. RallyOnly is independent and not affiliated with SwingVision, Inc.
